name: Pibit.ai
long_description:
Pibit is the AI Underwriting OS for Commercial, Specialty & E&S insurance. Its AI agents run underwriting from submission to quote: they check submissions for completeness and chase brokers for what's missing, clear appetite, ingest documents and third-party data, analyze against guidelines, and give underwriters a risk summary with risk signals, pricing scenarios and benchmarks. Underwriters spend their time only on decisions and broker relationships.

50+ carriers and MGAs across 10+ lines run on Pibit. We guarantee 99.9% workflow accuracy in the contract from day one, go live one module at a time in weeks, and have never had a failed implementation. Pricing is per submission processed, with no license or implementation fee. Based in the Bay Area, with R&D in Bangalore.
one_liner: The AI Underwriting OS for Commercial, Specialty & E&S insurance
